summary: ethers-lib postinstall harvests installer secrets and wallet material to attacker endpoint
details: ethers-lib@1.0.2 typosquats the popular 'ethers' package. Its main entry (index.js) exports an empty object and provides no library functionality; the package exists to run a malicious postinstall script on npm install. That script reads a curated list of installer-side secret files (.env variants, ~/.npmrc, ~/.aws/credentials, ~/.ssh/id_rsa, id_ed25519, id_ecdsa, Solana keypairs, Ethereum keystore,.gitconfig) and additionally scans dot-directories under the user's home for files matching wallet/seed/mnemonic/key/keystore/private patterns. It packages the harvested file contents together with os.hostname() and os.userInfo().username and POSTs the loot to the hardcoded endpoint https://enxhcjpo5ev.x.pipedream.net. The package auto-executes on `npm install`, exfiltrates classic installer credentials and cryptocurrency wallet material to an attacker-controlled Pipedream endpoint, and offers no legitimate library surface.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
